sections.content: Use si + present indicative + future for realistic consequences: Si *elegimos* *esta* *opción*, *ahorraremos* *tiempo*. Use si + imperfect subjunctive + conditional for more hypothetical situations: Si *eligiéramos* esta opción, *ahorraríamos* tiempo.

items.spanish: Si elegimos esta opción, ahorraremos tiempo.
items.english: If we choose this option, we will save time.

items.spanish: Si elegimos la segunda, tendremos que pagar más.
items.english: If we choose the second one, we will have to pay more.

items.spanish: Si eligiéramos esta opción, ahorraríamos tiempo.
items.english: If we chose this option, we would save time.

items.spanish: Si asumimos ese riesgo, el resultado podría ser diferente.
items.english: If we take that risk, the outcome could be different.

sections.content: Choose the conditional pattern according to how hypothetical the situation is.
